_about: Type template 'German Werkplan EFH' (PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §43, §43.16). Editable. Values the scan cannot read come from here, each with its source.

opening_series._source: DIN 4172 Maßordnung im Hochbau, module 12.5 cm, 1 cm joint: Öffnungsmaß x*12.5 + 1 cm (BauNetz Wissen, 'Steinformat und Maßordnung', table mw_masse_2)

wall_series._source: same table: Außenmaß x*12.5 - 1 cm. Planziegel follow their own system (same page): a wall READ on the drawing wins

window_system._status: YELLOW: the drawing does not state a profile. frame_face_mm and pane_mm copied from the §34 template default; depth = the wall's READ thickness (the §34 convention, depth from the plan); height and sill = registry defaults (no norm value found)
window_system._sash_source: Dreh-Kipp windows usually 500-1250 mm wide (aroundhome.de 'Fenster Maße', consumer source): sashes = ceil(width / 1250)

door_series._source: DIN 18101 via BauNetz Wissen 'Wandöffnungen und Türgrößen nach DIN 18101' (.../konstruktion-funktion/wandoeffnungen-und-tuergroessen-nach-din-18101-155227: Nennmaß = Baurichtmaß + 10 mm width, + 5 mm height) and 'Türblattgrößen nach DIN 18101' (.../konstruktion-funktion/tuerblattgroessen-nach-din-18101-155263), read 2026-11-23; PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §43.21

height_mm._status: YELLOW: the two pages disagree (2005 vs 2010); not resolved

door_system._status: YELLOW: the scan does not draw the frame or leaf at a readable scale. frame_face_mm and leaf_mm copied from the §38 'Low cost single storey unit' door_system; depth = the wall's READ thickness (the §34 convention); height = door_series opening Nennmaß (§43.21 step 2, DEFAULT)

fixture_symbols._about: §52.5 (owner 2026-11-24: 'markings of toilet/sink ... insert mesh from library'). How the plan DRAWS a sanitary fixture, measured on DE-1 (scan 200 dpi; log /tmp/claude-1000/s52/fixtures_*.log): a closed shape (white region bounded by ink, ink = grey < 215), its bbox in metres, its fill share of the bbox, and the drain / tap mark inside it (its AREA in mm2: ink pixels inside the shape's box, 2 px in from its edges, that are not the shape: the mark may touch the rim). Ranges bracket the measured shapes; a shape outside every row is not placed. The fixture body comes from the Modeller's catalog (bim-ootb DXF2BIM §L46); this table only says what a drawn shape IS.

basin.measured: OG 0.526 / 0.484 / 0.484 / 0.498 x 0.277 / 0.277 / 0.291 / 0.291 fill 0.91-0.95, marks 16-25 px at 72.2 px/m (3066-4790 mm2); EG 0.482 x 0.281 fill 0.91, mark 7 px at 49.8 px/m (2825 mm2): the mark is an AREA, the print scale differs per sheet

bath.measured: OG 1.107 x 0.415 fill 0.95; mark 53 px (10156 mm2, the drain arrow)

prewall._about: §55.1 (owner 2026-11-24: refer to industry defaults; the user edits). A WC pre-wall (Vorwandinstallation) as the plan draws it, measured on DE-1 OG (s55/prewall_probe.log): an unhatched strip between the WC's back-wall face and a straight line parallel to it. The line must run at least min_run_m (the narrowest WC pre-wall element) at a distance within depth_m of the wall face. Height = the common WC pre-wall element height (DEFAULT, editable in the Modeller).
prewall.height_source: DEFAULT industry: WC pre-wall element height 1.12 m
